q: Fetch campaign-level ad spend, orders, cost per order (CPA) and net ROAS for the top 5 Meta campaigns by spend over 2026-10-07..2026-10-08 and 2026-10-06..2026-10-07 for comparison.
answer:
Short answer: I pulled Meta campaign-level ad spend (paid_media) and the matching orders, CPA and net ROAS (order-date / order_pnl) for the campaigns that were the top 5 by Meta spend in each period. Where a campaign ranked in paid_media but had no matching order_pnl row the orders/CPA/ROAS are reported as "No data" (not zero). Key numbers below.

What I did and the raw results (previous period = 2026-10-06..2026-10-07; current = 2026-10-07..2026-10-08). Campaigns were ranked by Meta ad spend in each period (paid_media); orders/CPA/ROAS are the last-touch order-date P&L slice.

- TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE-6OCT
  - Prev spend ₹8,145 · Orders 9 · CPA ₹905 · Net ROAS 1.5
  - Curr spend ₹17,251 · Orders 13 · CPA ₹1,327 · Net ROAS 1.0
- TH-222-WINGBIRD-23SEP
  - Prev spend ₹16,111 · Orders 16 · CPA ₹1,007 · Net ROAS 0.6
  - Curr spend ₹14,884 · Orders 18 · CPA ₹827 · Net ROAS 0.9
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-29SEP
  - Prev spend ₹15,856 · Orders 7 · CPA ₹2,265 · Net ROAS 0.3
  - Curr spend ₹11,659 · Orders 6 · CPA ₹1,943 · Net ROAS 0.5
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+
  - Prev spend ₹12,633 · Orders: No data · CPA: No data · Net ROAS: No data
  - Curr spend ₹11,989 · Orders: No data · CPA: No data · Net ROAS: No data
- (period-specific 5th campaigns)
  - Prev 5th: CAT TOY CS-26SEP — Prev spend ₹9,049 · Orders 7 · CPA ₹1,293 · Net ROAS 0.7
  - Curr 5th: TH-279-BATHEASEBRUSH-07OCT — Curr spend ₹7,749 · Orders: No data · CPA: No data · Net ROAS: No data

Notes and data gaps:
- Ranking used paid_media.Ad spend (Meta) for each period; orders/CPA/net ROAS come from order_pnl (order-date, last-touch attribution). These are different Cube views/time axes and were run separately, so some campaigns that appear in paid_media have no matching order_pnl row in that two-day window (shown as "No data"). The queries were scoped to the default brand (Tilting Heads).
- Data freshness: paid_media is near real-time; order_pnl hourly. Data as of 2026-10-14; no brand filter explicitly supplied (scoped to Tilting Heads).

Worth checking: re-run the order_pnl query for the specific campaigns that show "No data" (TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+, TH-279-BATHEASEBRUSH-07OCT) with campaign_name equals those names so we can compare like-for-like across both views.
